reviews.text:
Dr. Namiki is a very kind and thorough doctor. All of my past dogs have been treated by him. Even if the wait is long, I want him to see my dog. Recently, there are also younger doctors who are just as thorough as Dr. Namiki, so the wait isn't too long.

My family and I are saying how glad we are to have found such a trustworthy doctor.
Great care and a great vet.

My dog ​​has received treatment here several times. He had been going to another animal hospital for a skin condition that wasn't getting better, so we went to Dr. Namiki. He immediately diagnosed a dental problem, and it turned out his pulp was exposed. He also correctly identified the cause of the broken tooth, extracted it, and the skin condition healed completely. It's a bit far, but if anything happens again, I would definitely like to go back and have him examined there.
There's a long wait, but all the teachers are nice, and the prices are reasonable, so my child is being cared for here.

This is a truly excellent vet! My cat has been a patient here for 5 years.
The staff are kind, and above all, the vet's skills are superb.

The teachers are very kind and polite.
It's always crowded with people lining up.
Take a registration number.

I received care from them when I lived in Setagaya Ward, and even though I've moved and now live far away, I still rely on them in emergencies.

I am incredibly grateful to Director Namiki, the doctors, and the staff.

I also appreciate how everyone always talks to the cats, saying "They're so cute, so cute."

Our three cats (two of them rescue cats) received excellent care here. The doctor and staff are incredibly kind. We entrusted them with everything from treating two abandoned tabby kittens—colds, eye discharge, neutering, etc.—to their care. Thank you so much. They're doing so well now.
All of my children are cared for by this teacher. I have complete confidence in the teacher's skills, so I don't mind things like the small size of the facility or the unfriendly reception staff.
Wonderful and caring veterinary doctor and staff.

My cats will be in your care. I am very grateful for the warm welcome you have given to the cats we rescued during our animal rescue activities.

Please take care of yourselves, everyone at the clinic.
This doctor is so reliable I'd give him 10 stars. That's why, even though the wait is always long and he lives far away, I go to see him every time.
The teachers' support is excellent. I am truly grateful for their constant consideration of my circumstances.

I'm truly grateful for the kindness and helpfulness I always receive from the doctor and staff. I'm a foreigner and my Japanese isn't very good, but they always take the time to explain things slowly and kindly. It's a local animal hospital and always crowded, but I think it's definitely worth the wait.
He is skilled and the treatment costs are reasonable.

A rescued mixed breed dog passed away the other day at the age of 9. They continued to treat him until the very end. I was deeply touched when they offered flowers for his ashes. Everyone, including the director, was very kind to me. Thank you very much.

The nurses' skill and kindness have helped to alleviate the stress my child is going through. Dr. Namiki's timely examinations have saved many lives. I have known Dr. Namiki, a person of great character, for 12 years. This is a truly dedicated, careful, and considerate clinic.

I've treated two of my pets here, but in both cases their condition had deteriorated significantly before they were referred to Tokyo University of Agriculture and Technology Hospital. I wish they had referred them there sooner.
As the reviews suggest, the reason it's so busy is probably because the director is a very kind person and the treatment fees are reasonable.
But the examination rooms are small and cluttered, and the waiting room is too small.
Honestly, I wonder if the clutter in these examination rooms means medical errors don't happen? The treatment room in the back is so small and messy that it's difficult for owners to be present.
It's hardly a tidy and clean environment. What's more, people wait on the street in front of the hospital, to the point that it's a nuisance to the neighbors. The same goes for the parking lot. This isn't a ramen shop, so surely lines like this shouldn't exist?

In other words, they're not investing enough in facilities for their patients. If there's such a long wait, they should introduce a system to arrange appointments before people even come to the clinic (there is a QR code call function, but it's not very useful unless you live nearby), move to a property with a larger waiting room, change the accounting system, and other such measures. Instead of doing anything like that, I can't help but feel that the director's friendly and caring manner with pet owners and his reasonable prices have made them loyal followers. I do think they do care deeply about animals, though...
The receptionists and nurses are so busy that they can only provide a routine, sloppy service, so I think I'll stop leaving urgent illnesses and injuries to them. Some people might feel uncomfortable if they trust the star reviews too much.
